Advisors are said to be actively engaged on the potential transaction, which is reported to carry a multi billion dollar valuation. The possible Infineum divestment highlights only one piece of ExxonMobil's wider portfolio and risk profile. Our analysis turns up 1 major warning sign for ExxonMobil Holdings as well.
